name: Point Cloud Voxelization via Discretization and Accumulation
aliases: binary occupancy grid from point cloud
definition: A method to convert a 3D point cloud into a binary voxel grid (occupancy grid) by discretizing point coordinates into a regular grid and marking voxels as occupied if they contain at least one point.
summary: Point Cloud Voxelization via Discretization and Accumulation converts irregular 3D point clouds into binary occupancy grids by binning coordinates and accumulating counts, distinguishing itself through direct coordinate binning rather than feature storage or sorting.
